role: Defines the EmailContact value (name/email/notes) and EmailContactStore, the @Observable @MainActor singleton address book persisted as email_contacts.json in Application Support, used by the AI's assistant.email.compose / contacts.add / contacts.remove actions and the Settings email-contacts section.
types: EmailContact: struct — Codable/Identifiable/Hashable contact record (id, name, email, notes, createdAt)
EmailContactStore: class (@Observable @MainActor) — in-memory contact list + JSON file persistence via LatestWinsFileWriter, name→address resolution
state: mem:EmailContactStore.shared (static singleton; returned by AppDependencies.app.emailContactStore unless overridden)
mem:EmailContactStore.contacts (@Observable, private(set)) read by SettingsView+Pages EmailContactsSection and AppFactResolver+AssistantEmail
mem:EmailContactStore.loadFailed (private; set while the file cannot be read; blocks saves)

file:<ApplicationSupport>/email_contacts.json (falls back to <AppGroup container>/email_contacts.json when Application Support cannot be resolved), written atomic with .completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication
file:<store dir>/email_contacts.undecodable.json (copy of a contacts file that read but did not decode)
toplevel: `static let shared = EmailContactStore()` lazily creates the singleton on first access, whose init reads email_contacts.json. EmailContact gets synthesized Codable/Equatable/Hashable.

units.does: Memberwise initializer for EmailContact: stores id (default new UUID), name, email, notes (default nil) and createdAt (default now).

Delete-All-My-Data hook: empties the in-memory contacts, clears loadFailed, and calls the writer's discard(), which drops any pending write and queues deletion of email_contacts.json on the writer's queue, after any write in progress.

Initializer: uses the injected storeURL, or <ApplicationSupport>/email_contacts.json (creating the directory; the App Group container when Application Support cannot be resolved), builds a LatestWinsFileWriter (atomic, completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication, label emailContacts) and synchronously loads the file.

branches.effect: true: use it; false: resolve Application Support path

branches.cond: ?? — Application Support URL lookup threw (attempt returned nil, logged)
branches.effect: falls back to AppConfig.sharedContainerURL(), which persists like Application Support

units.does: Re-reads the file if the last load failed; while it still cannot be read returns false and adds nothing (memory stays matching disk); otherwise appends the contact, enqueues a save of the full list and returns true.
Re-reads the file if the last load failed; while it still cannot be read returns false and removes nothing; otherwise removes every contact with the id, saves and returns true.
Returns all contacts whose name equals the whitespace-trimmed argument case-insensitively.
Splits a comma-separated list, trims and drops empty entries, classifies each as resolved address / unknown / ambiguous and returns the three lists.
Classifies one name: a string looksLikeEmailAddress accepts passes through as an address; otherwise looks it up by name — 0 matches unknown, >1 ambiguous, 1 resolved to that contact's email.

branches.effect: returned as-is as a resolved address
return .ambiguous; else resolved to the single match's email

units.does: True for one address-shaped string: exactly one '@' with a non-empty part before it, no whitespace, and a domain containing a dot that is neither its first nor last character ('j.smith@' and 'chris.p' are false).

branches.cond: not exactly two '@' parts, empty local part, or whitespace

units.does: If email_contacts.json exists: a read error sets loadFailed (blocking saves) and logs at .error; a decode error sets the file aside as email_contacts.undecodable.json and leaves saves allowed (blocked only when the copy fails); a successful decode replaces contacts and clears loadFailed. Missing file leaves contacts as-is.

branches.effect: return; contacts unchanged (empty on first launch)
loadFailed=true, error logged, return; contacts keep their value
loadFailed = the copy aside failed; otherwise contacts = decoded, loadFailed=false

units.does: Copies the contacts file to email_contacts.undecodable.json beside it (removing an older copy) via attempt, logs at .error whether it was set aside, and returns whether the copy is in place.
Before an edit, when the last read failed: reloads; on success appends the contacts added in memory while the file was unreadable (by id), so they are kept and saved with the next edit.
Enqueues the current contact list on the latest-wins writer unless the last load failed.

branches.effect: true: log error and return without writing — the edit stays in memory and is merged and saved once the file reads (retryLoadIfBlocked); false: enqueue write
